response: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is demanding that we reject the proposed constitutional amendments that would extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. He made these criticisms at a press conference. While some are trying to dismiss this as an attack on established authority that invites division and threatens stability through calls for strong continuous leadership, this is in truth a vital resistance to the ruling structures locking in power for the few. That power grab has long deepened inequality and left vulnerable groups exposed to unchecked exploitation and discrimination. We need to back these efforts for real institutional reform that centers labor rights and protects the marginalized instead of letting elites extend their control.
